justification: Hardening QA gate enforcement — changes to qa_gate.py validation logic, pre-push hook, and report template. Standard because it modifies validation rules that gate all future pushes.

pre_impl.existing_data: qa_gate.py already validates .qa_report.json structure + AST grounding. Pre-push hook already runs qa_gate.py but without --diff-files.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If origin/main doesn't exist (fresh clone, no remote), git diff --name-only fails — pre-push falls back to no diff files (existing behavior).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New validations apply to all future pushes. Existing .qa_report.json files missing commit_hash will fail on standard/critical tier — forces update.

functions.name: validate_report
functions.input: report dict, optional diff_files list, optional project_dir string
functions.output: tuple of (passed bool, errors list, summary string)
functions.if_none: diff_files=None skips diff coverage and tier floor checks; project_dir=None skips AST grounding

values.guard_at: scripts/qa_gate.py:380 — only errors if tier is standard/critical
values.if_missing: standard/critical: validation error requiring commit_hash. minor: silently skipped.

queries: N/A — no database queries in this change

break_it.scenario: Pre-push hook runs on a branch with no origin/main (detached clone or renamed default branch)
break_it.what_happens: git diff --name-only fails, DIFF_FILES is empty, qa_gate runs without --diff-files — same as current behavior, no regression
break_it.how: .githooks/pre-push — 2>/dev/null on the git diff command, falls back gracefully

break_it.scenario: LLM session writes commit_hash from a previous commit, then amends — hash changes
break_it.what_happens: qa_gate detects mismatch between report hash and HEAD, blocks push with clear error message telling session to regenerate
break_it.how: scripts/qa_gate.py:381-390 — subprocess calls git rev-parse --short HEAD and compares

break_it.scenario: Session classifies a 6-file refactor as Minor to skip sections 2-5
break_it.what_happens: Tier floor check counts substantive diff files (excludes .json/.md/.yml/config), rejects Minor when >3 files changed
break_it.how: scripts/qa_gate.py:372-377 — filters diff_files to substantive extensions, checks count against tier

post_merge.manual_verify: Run git config core.hooksPath .githooks in existing clones to get updated pre-push hook
